name: @entur/smart-avvik-firebase-notifications
description: Firestore-backed inbox, alert ledger, Cloud Functions receiver and security rules for Entur's journey notification webhooks.

scripts.pretest: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const files = fs.existsSync('test') ? fs.readdirSync('test').filter(file => file.endsWith('.test.mjs')) : []; if (files.length === 0) { console.error('No test/*.test.mjs files found'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run build:client
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-smartavvikclient --only firestore --config firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=60000 --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON test/emulator/*.test.mjs"

//: overrides.@firebase/app: firebase 13.0.0 pins @firebase/app 0.16.3 while the other @firebase packages (0.x peer) dedupe to the 0.16.2 that firebase-admin pulls in through @firebase/database-compat, so the client SDK got two app registries and the emulator suite failed with 'Service firestore is not available'. Remove the override once `npm ls @firebase/app` shows a single version without it.
